as_told.title: Lights over Duke Energy plant video

plain: Lights were filmed in 2024 near Duke Energy's Brunswick nuclear power plant in Southport, North Carolina, a case Michels raises himself on two episodes. In one he gives the exact place. In another he calls it "quote unquote UAP activity" (UAP stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's newer word for UFOs) and credits Mick West, a skeptic known for analysing UFO videos, with identifying the facility only as Duke Energy's. He brings it up as one more example of unexplained objects seen near nuclear sites, which would matter if something were watching those sites.
